height.$description: Minimum block size and inline target of an action.

bg.$description: Surface of a floating action: a tonal fill, or in onmars v2 the raised surface with a hairline, so the accent stays on selection.

fg.$description: Label and icon ink on the action surface.

bg-image.$description: Optional image painted above the action fill.

backdrop-filter.$description: Complete optional filter behind the action.

border-width.$description: Width of the action edge. A tonal action draws none; onmars v2 edges its surface actions with a hairline.

border-color.$description: Color of the action edge, drawn at border-width.

font-weight.$description: Text weight of an action label.

line-height.$description: Line height of an action label.

icon-size.$description: Size of the glyph preceding an action label.

content-gap.$description: Space between the action glyph and label.

padding-block.$description: Block padding for a wrapping action label.
